analysis.reasonEn: Current price $141.46 approaches the lower Bollinger Band at $131.23. RSI at 37.9 is entering oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving at -0.1522 but remains negative. Overall, a phase for observation rather than immediate buying, awaiting further indicator confirmation.
